== Summary ==
Players Committee full-face image of [[Hypo (PC Errata 3)]], with the printed <code>D-E1</code> mark. This file shows the published PC remake rather than the original Decipher face.

== Source ==
* [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/48d57c17d760f4bb25b4d55459f709eef5f8cb82/Images-HT/starwars/ANewHope-Dark/hires/hypo.png Players Committee Holotable image], repository record of 27 January 2024 (UTC). The first publication day may be earlier.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/ANewHope-Dark/large/hypo.gif Current official card image].

The existing file bytes are retained. Its decoded card pixels match the linked 2024 source, although the PNG files differ in encoding. Earlier partial and full-face sources are documented at [[Hypo (PC Errata)]] and [[Hypo (PC Errata 2)]].
